body.goal: Resume the already-requested New Westside design-level benchmark after transport repair. Do not start a different parent goal.
instructions: Reconcile the original benchmark task and execute it now.

Produce a genuinely new New Westside opening design using real Westside content; do not submit Dawn Atlas, Living Current, Signal Nocturne, homepage v1/v2/v3, or the prior internal-loop compositions as the answer.
Materialize an editable artifact and verify it in a real browser on desktop and mobile.
Return artifact path, browser evidence, design rationale, provisional design judgment, and bounded result evidence.
Do not claim user aesthetic acceptance, production promotion, or final Westside style acceptance.
body.pass_boundary: A transport receipt alone is not PASS. PASS requires a new design artifact plus real-browser desktop/mobile evidence and a canonical result for this benchmark.
